name: CRAG-MM
description: Wearable devices such as smart glasses are transforming the way people interact with their surroundings, enabling real-time queries about entities in view. While Multi-Modal Retrieval-Augmented Generation (MM-RAG) plays a key role in grounding these queries in factual knowledge, the field lacks a comprehensive benchmark tailored to the unique challenges of wearable, egocentric scenarios. To fill this gap, we present CRAG-MM, a Comprehensive RAG benchmark for Multi-modal Multi-turn conversations. CRAG-MM contains a diverse set of 6.5K (image, question, answer) triplets and 2K vision-based multi-turn conversations across 13 domains. Distinctively, it features 6.2K egocentric images designed to emulate wearable captures, incorporating real-world complexities such as varying image quality. Concretely, CRAG-MM includes five types of low-quality images, six question types, varying entity popularity, differing information dynamism, and multi-turn dependencies. The benchmark evaluates three core tasks: single-source augmentation, multi-source augmentation, and multi-turn QA—each paired with a dedicated retrieval corpus and optional APIs for image-KG and web search. Empirically, straightforward MM-RAG approaches achieve only 32% and 43% truthfulness on single- and multi-turn QA, respectively, while state-of-the-art industry solutions reach just 32% and 45%, revealing substantial headroom for future progress. The benchmark has hosted a leaderboard that attracted approximately a thousand participants, with winning solutions improving baseline performance by 28%, highlighting its early impact on advancing the field. CRAG-MM is publicly available at https://huggingface.co/crag-mm-2025.
